shape: Dense 3-portal hub with NE clique + south arm (S+E+W gates)
description: Three-portal hub with three distinct interior zones: a long western backbone (q572l1 → 06hvnc → 2g426j → yl6mpd) connecting spawn_west to the south entry, a center pivot (z8i9ex) branching into a south-pocket clique (hf99gj + x6cvpg + a5zgrz + uhjwjc) and an east-side clique (9iol5f + oyoryw + dsfzp1 + rbt407), and an east entry hub (zkclcj) that joins via the south-pocket / east-clique cross-links. Same primitive family as paru-A td2 (dense 3-portal hub) — strict-backbone applies because plant-style obstacles break the floor between authored anchors.

portals.south: spawn_south at (6.06, 23.06) — gate on the south (high-Z) side
portals.east: spawn_east at (24.79, -8.05) — gate on the east (high-X) side
portals.west: spawn_west at (-23.23, -5.13) — gate on the west (low-X) side

anchors.description: center pivot — branches to south-pocket clique + east clique (matches z8i9ex)
east-inner south (south pocket ↔ east clique bridge) (matches uhjwjc)

traversalNotes: west ↔ south: spawn_west → west_inner → west_n → south_arm_w → south_arm_n → south_inner → spawn_south.
south ↔ east: spawn_south → south_inner → south_arm_n → center → east_inner_s → east_inner → spawn_east (or via south_arm_n → east_hub_s → east-clique → east_inner).
west ↔ east:  spawn_west → west_inner → west_n → south_arm_n → center → east_inner_s → east_inner → spawn_east.
SOUTH-POCKET CLIQUE (south_pkt_c + sw_pocket + se_pocket + east_inner_s) is a dense combat / objective sub-area below the center.
EAST CLIQUE (east_hub_s + east_mid + east_n + ne_corner) is a side combat arena reached via south_arm_n or center.
STRICT-BACKBONE applies — plant-style obstacles fill the floor between authored anchors.
Same primitive family as paru-A td2 (dense 3-portal hub) with three distinct sub-cliques.
